question: Your phone used to last all day. Since you started a new job, it is flat by 4 pm. Why?
answer: Weak signal. A phone in poor coverage turns up its radio's transmit power and keeps searching for a better mast, and that can cost more than the screen. Nothing in the phone changed; only the room did. iPhones even list it on the battery screen as Low Signal. The basement ate the battery.
move: When a problem comes and goes, ask what else comes and goes with it.
ask: What problem in my week happens only in one place, or only with one person?

clues.text: Same phone, same habits. Since the new job started, it's flat by 4 pm.
Settings: battery health 99%. The phone is six months old.
Screen time is under two hours a day, just as it always was.
At weekends, with the same apps and the same use, it still lasts all day.
Your new desk is in a basement: one bar of signal, often none.

scene.why: Weekends kept the apps and changed only the place. A phone hunting for a mast burns power.

reference: Apple, iPhone User Guide, battery usage and the Low Signal insight in Settings > Battery, 2024, https://support.apple.com/guide/iphone/
